kernel_output.flsa_commission_basis: 29 CFR 778.117 (commission payments are payments for hours worked and must be included in the regular rate)
kernel_output.scope_note: Models the gross W-2 of an OTE offer only: base salary plus variable pay as a function of quota attainment, with an optional accelerator tier and an optional recoverable draw. It computes NO tax liability: after_tax_at_target is gross W-2 times a single caller-supplied flat federal rate, which ignores the standard deduction and the 2026 marginal bracket schedule in Rev. Proc. 2025-32 sec. 4.01 (recorded above as named literals, not applied). No state tax, no FICA, no pre-tax deductions, no benefits load. It computes NO FLSA regular rate and NO overtime: see FLSA_COMMISSION_BASIS and cross-reference node art-340-compute-flsa-regular-rate, and note the duty test at 29 CFR 541.500. The risk labels (high/moderate/low at 60%/40% of OTE in variable pay), the 6-month clawback threshold and the 25-point highlight bucket are the Apex tool's own editorial constants with no cited source; they are not regulatory. The draw/clawback figures are arithmetic on the caller-supplied draw, not a reading of any offer letter or of wage law. NOT TAX ADVICE, NOT WAGE-HOUR LEGAL ADVICE, NOT COMPENSATION ADVICE.
